title: R Draconis — a pulsating giant star
plain_result: 1635 SPHEREx pictures. This star really changes brightness, so every view should keep flagging it; measuring how much it changes needs one brightness per picture after removing its colour, which we have not done yet. Below are the raw counts of flagged changes in this patch for each view, without interpretation.

numbers.label: Flagged changes, one detector at a time

method_note: Counts use the same rule as the 20-patch test (groups of ≥ 2 pixels beyond 5σ).
